subject: english

knowledge.name: try to do 与 try doing
knowledge.explanation: try to do sth 表示努力去做某事，try doing sth 表示试着做某事（尝试某种办法）。

knowledge.name: afraid of 与 good at
knowledge.explanation: be afraid of doing sth 害怕做某事，be good at doing sth 擅长做某事，两个短语后都接动名词。
prerequisites: try to do 与 try doing

knowledge.name: Past tense 叙述尝试经历
knowledge.explanation: 讲过去的尝试用一般过去时：I tried skating for the first time last month. 否定用 didn't + 动词原形。

knowledge.name: Encouragement 鼓励与建议
knowledge.explanation: 鼓励别人用 Don't be afraid to try. / You can do it.；提建议用 Why don't you try…? 或 You should try…
prerequisites: Past tense 叙述尝试经历

questions.analysis: afraid 是形容词，否定要用 be 动词，A 正确；B 缺 be，C 缺 be 且 to 缺失，D 祈使句缺 to。

questions.stem: She is good at （  ） the piano.
questions.analysis: be good at 后接动名词，play 变 playing；B 缺 -ing，C 第三人称单数形式，D 过去式都不符合。

questions.stem: I want to （  ） （try） rock climbing this summer.
questions.analysis: want to 后接动词原形，填 try；写 trying 则与 to 冲突。
questions.knowledge_point: try to do 与 try doing

questions.stem: try doing sth 和 try to do sth 意思完全相同。
questions.analysis: try to do 强调努力去做，try doing 强调试着采用某种做法，语义有差别，不能等同。
questions.knowledge_point: try to do 与 try doing

questions.stem: — I'm afraid of speaking English in class. — （  ）
options: Don't worry. Try to speak more.
You are right to be afraid.
So do I, let's give up.
questions.analysis: 面对害怕情绪应鼓励并给建议，A 符合交际逻辑；B、C、D 都是放弃或否定，不能起到鼓励作用。

questions.stem: Last summer I （  ） （try） swimming in the sea for the first time.
questions.analysis: Last summer 是过去时间，try 变 tried（辅音字母+y 结尾改 y 为 i 再加 ed）。
questions.knowledge_point: Past tense 叙述尝试经历

questions.stem: 下列表达中，语法正确的有（  ）
questions.analysis: A good at + 动名词 ✓；B afraid of + 动名词 ✓；C afraid to 后应接动词原形，用 flying ✗；D try to + 动词原形 ✓。故 A、B、D 成立，C 不成立。

questions.stem: He didn't tried skating last week. 这句话语法正确。
questions.analysis: didn't 后要用动词原形，应为 didn't try，不能用过去式 tried。
questions.knowledge_point: Past tense 叙述尝试经历

questions.stem: 「我试着用另一种方法解这道题」更贴近哪个表达？（  ）
options: I tried solving the problem in another way.
I tried to solve the problem in another way.
questions.analysis: 「试着用另一种办法」强调尝试某种做法，用 try doing，A 更贴近；B 强调努力去解；C、D 缺 to 或用过去式，语法错误。
questions.knowledge_point: try to do 与 try doing

questions.stem: — I failed the tryout. — （  ） you try again? （填助动词）
questions.analysis: 提建议可用 Why don't you…?，填 Why don't；也可用 You should，但题干已给出 you try again 的顺序。

questions.stem: 关于一般过去时，说法正确的有（  ）
options: 否定句用 didn't + 动词原形
疑问句用 did + 主语 + 动词原形
questions.analysis: A 规则动词过去式加 -ed ✓；B 否定用 didn't + 原形 ✓；C 疑问用 did 引导、动词还原 ✓；D was 只用于 I/he/she/it，复数用 were ✗。故 A、B、C 成立，D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: Past tense 叙述尝试经历

questions.stem: be afraid of 后面可以接动名词，也可以接名词。
questions.analysis: afraid of 是介词短语，介词后接名词或动名词都成立，如 afraid of dogs、afraid of flying。

questions.stem: 下面哪句是正确的过去时句子？（  ）
options: She tried rock climbing last Sunday.
She try rock climbing last Sunday.
She tried rock climbing next Sunday.
She tries rock climbing last Sunday.
questions.analysis: last Sunday 是过去时间，动词用 tried，A 正确；B 用原形，C 时间与过去式矛盾，D 用现在时第三人称单数。
questions.knowledge_point: Past tense 叙述尝试经历

questions.stem: He is afraid of （  ） （fail） again, so he practises every day.
questions.analysis: afraid of 后接动名词，fail 变 failing；写 fail 缺 -ing。

questions.stem: Why don't you try it? 是一种委婉的建议。
questions.analysis: Why don't you…? 表面是问句，实际是建议对方试一试，语气委婉，说法正确。

questions.stem: 用英语写三句话，讲述你第一次尝试某件事的经历：一句写时间，一句写做了什么，一句写感受。

answer.value: Last year I tried ice skating for the first time. I fell down twice but I didn't give up. I felt proud of myself.

questions.analysis: 参考示例见答案。评分要点：①用过去时（2 分）；②三句分别覆盖时间、行为、感受（2 分）；③用上 try 或 try doing（1 分）；④大小写与标点（1 分）。全篇用现在时不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: Past tense 叙述尝试经历

questions.stem: 把句子补全并译成中文：Tom is good （  ） （  ） （swim）, but he is afraid （  ） diving.

answer.value: at swimming；of。译文：汤姆擅长游泳，但他害怕跳水。

questions.analysis: 参考答案：good at swimming（be good at + 动名词）；afraid of（be afraid of + 动名词/名词）。译文见答案。评分要点：①两处搭配正确（2 分）；②swim 变 swimming（1 分）；③译文准确（1 分）；④标点（1 分）。写成 good in swimming 或 afraid to diving 不得分。

questions.stem: 「他去年加入了机器人社团，因为他想尝试新事物」的英文是（  ）
options: He joined the robot club last year because he wanted to try new things.
He joins the robot club last year because he wants to try new things.
He joined the robot club last year so he wanted to try new things.
He joined the robot club next year because he wanted to try new things.
questions.analysis: last year 要求过去时 joined / wanted，因果用 because 且不同时用 so，A 正确；B 时态错，C 因果连词误用，D 时间状语自相矛盾。
questions.knowledge_point: Past tense 叙述尝试经历
